paths.name: tailwind-merge
paths.message: Import `cn` from @/lib/utils — it configures tailwind-merge with the system's named type scale. Bare twMerge silently drops `text-outcome`, `text-help` and friends.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex colour. Helm has four hues and they all live in styles/design-system/tokens/colors.css — use a token (`text-sea`, `bg-drift`, `border-border-strong`).
Raw hex colour. Helm has four hues and they all live in styles/design-system/tokens/colors.css — use a token.
Tailwind's default palette is not in this system. Navy, verdigris, brass and one red — brass means drift, the red means irreversible destruction. See lib/design/README.md.
Surfaces are chart paper and navy, never pure white or black. Use `bg-card`, `bg-background`, `bg-navy-deep`, `text-foreground`.

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/(?:^|[\s"'>(])(?:Oops|Great!|Action required|Attention needed|On track|At risk|Nice work|All set)(?:$|[\s"'<).!])/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Banned vocabulary. Helm does not congratulate, does not manufacture urgency, and does not convert a judgement into a label nobody made. See the message library in lib/design/README.md.
